text_block_list.text:
Today is the filming day for a commercial 
featuring Narita Taishin. As her trainer, 
I accompanied her to the set, but—

text_block_list.name: Filming Staff
text_block_list.text:
"Cutting the camera for a moment! Could 
the two cast members please take a break!"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Yeeees!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I was nervous at first, but it 
started getting more and more fun!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, Ticket is so expressive, she really 
conveys how fun the game is. Surprisingly, 
she might actually be cut out for this 
kind of work.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Hayahide, you're done filming, right? 
Shouldn't you just head on back?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Since I have the chance, I figured I'd 
stick around and watch the photoshoot for 
the two of you.

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: WAAAAAAAHN! It brokeeeee!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, huh!? A child is crying!? Oh no, 
this is an emergency!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
What's wrong, what happened?! I'll help 
you out, just tell me everything!

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
U-Uwaaah, my helicopter...! It crashed, 
and now it won't moooove!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: What?! A helicopter?!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Did you drop it when you fell? Hmm... The 
motor is running, but the propeller 
doesn't seem to be moving...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Th-This is bad! What do I do, how do we 
fix it!? I'll fix it— Well, I want to, but 
I don't get machines at all!

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
*hic*, I-It's not fixable...?! 
Uwaaaaaahhh!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... Give it here. The propeller's 
probably just slightly misaligned anyway. 
Fix the alignment and it should work like 
normal...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Taishin, you can fix it?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
No, I don't really get it either, but... 
I'll give it a try for now.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Waaah, you're amazing, Taishin!! Keep it 
up, do your best!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"This part goes here... and this is like 
that... Umm...?"

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
If the axis is here, wouldn't it have 
shifted to the right? In other words, the 
propeller's proper position would be 
here...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Ah, I see. So does that mean... like this?
(VROOM—!)

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
Wah, it flew...! The helicopter is 
fixed——!

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
Awesome, awesome, you're so awesome, Big 
Sis! You look like a skilled engineer, so 
cool!

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it, there's an engineer 
in that upcoming game too! Big Sis, you 
look just like a character from that 
game!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: No, it's really not that big of a deal...

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: Thanks! It's all thanks to you, Sis!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
You're amazing, Taishin! You fixed it up 
in a flash—it looked so cool!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
No, it's not like I did anything that big. 
You always make a big deal out of 
everything.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... After all, she's playing a 
mechanic right now. Hearing about a broken 
machine must have made her want to help.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Shut up.

text_block_list.name: Filming Staff
text_block_list.text:
We're resuming shooting! First up is the 
cut with Narita Taishin as the technician!

text_block_list.name: Filming Staff
text_block_list.text:
Alright, hold that position and start the 
motor... Ah, looking great! You've totally 
nailed it! Please keep that vibe for the 
real thing!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Yes, please.

text_block_list.name: Filming Staff
text_block_list.text:
Cut! Flawless, absolutely top tier! 
Alright, moving on to the next scene!

Afterward, Narita Taishin's photoshoot 
went smoothly, cranking out one best shot 
after another—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Waaah, I'm so moved~~! Taishin swooping in 
to save the day, and that kid's beaming 
smile! I'm so, sooo happy for them~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, come on, don't you start crying too... 
Just when the kid finally stopped, man.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I'll go take a break over there, then.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...'Thank you,' huh? Well, being a 
mechanic isn't so bad... I guess.

Alone in the shade of a tree, Narita 
Taishin pondered the child's words. Her 
expression softened, radiating quiet joy—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
You really didn't need to get that 
excited... I didn't even do anything that 
amazing, did I...?
choice_data_list:
Still, doing something for others really 
feels good, doesn't it?

Still, doing something for others really 
feels nice, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Huh? ...It's not like that, okay.

She coldly denies it, but her expression 
looks somewhat happy.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, I'm so moved~~! Seeing smiles really 
is the best reward of all, waaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, sheesh, you nag about every single 
little thing.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"Smiles are the best reward" hits the nail 
on the head, though. Don't you think?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ......Well, I suppose that's probably it.

As Narita Taishin gave a blunt reply and 
walked away, her back somehow seemed full 
of satisfaction—
